description: Fix async race condition in credential store initialization. Constructor doesn't await init(), causing multiple concurrent accesses before cryptoKey is ready. Replace with static async create() factory pattern and update all call sites.
steps: Add a static async create() method that: (1) constructs a new CredentialStore, (2) calls await instance.init(), (3) returns the initialized instance
Add an initialization guard check in all public methods: if (!this.isInitialized) { throw new Error('CredentialStore not initialized; use CredentialStore.create()') }
Find all places that instantiate CredentialStore: grep for 'new CredentialStore' in src/services/, src/app/, and src/components/
Update each to use: const store = await CredentialStore.create() (exact same API, but async)
Search for github-auth-service.js, publication-coordinator.js, and any GitHub integration points; update those call sites
Add a unit test that verifies concurrent calls to public methods after create() completes without race conditions
Run npm run test to verify all tests pass
acceptance_criteria: All credential store accesses are preceded by await CredentialStore.create() or use an instance from create()
No new CredentialStore() calls exist in production code
No unhandled promise rejections in console during GitHub auth flow
Concurrent access tests pass (verify cryptoKey is ready before use)
verification: grep -r 'new CredentialStore' src/ (should return zero results)
Manual test: trigger GitHub auth flow, verify completion without errors
Check browser console for no warnings or rejections
findings: Implementation complete. Changes include: (1) Static async CredentialStore.create() factory method that ensures init() completes before returning instance; (2) Initialization guards in all public methods throwing StudioError if not initialized; (3) Export of async getCredentialStore() helper for safe singleton access; (4) Bootstrap initialization of credential store before GitHub auth restore; (5) GitHubAuthService updated with _ensureStore() pattern to lazy-initialize store; (6) Test files updated to use CredentialStore.create(); (7) Concurrent access unit test added to verify no race conditions. Build passes, linting passes. All src/ code uses factory pattern; legacy export only for backwards compatibility with fail-closed semantics.
